designs.title: Dasara Gold Bangles (HD, with 3D turn)
designs.format: Instagram post + reel (9:16) with 3D turning shot
designs.idea: Clean premium look like big jewellery brand ads: HD studio picture of the bangles, soft cream background, a 3D turning shot, short classy text.
designs.caption:
Made for your Dasara. ✨

Handcrafted gold bangles with emeralds, rubies and sparkling white stones, set by hand with peacock motifs.

Wishing you and your family a very Happy Dasara! 🙏

DM or WhatsApp us to order.
steps: Tap Download video and Download picture.
Open Instagram, tap + and choose Reel. Pick the video.
Add a soft festive song from Instagram music.
Copy the caption and paste it. Then tap Share.

designs.caption:

steps: Tap each small picture to save it, and tap Download video.
Instagram post: choose all 4 pictures together (carousel) in order 1 to 4, paste the caption, and post around 7:30 PM.
Instagram reel: pick the video, add a trending Dasara song from Instagram's music, paste the caption, and share.

designs.title: Timeless Jhumkas
designs.idea: A festive post for our 22K plain jhumkas, maroon and gold.
designs.caption:
Some designs never go out of style. Our 22K hallmarked gold jhumkas, handcrafted for every festival and every wedding. ✨

DM us on WhatsApp to order.
steps: Open it in Canva and add your jhumka photo if it isn't there yet.
Tap Share, then Download, and save it as a picture.
Post it on Instagram around 7:30 PM, and paste the caption.
Share the same picture on your WhatsApp Status and Facebook.
